say:1:1411404001:1.text: Currently, about two-thirds of our raw ores are carried here, but in the future, we hope to reduce that amount.
say:1:1411404001:1.source_cn: 这里目前承载着三分之二左右的原矿供给，但今后我们会希望...

say:2:1411404002:1.text: Do you mean increasing the mining in the Sal'thorin area?
say:2:1411404002:1.source_cn: 你是说，提高萨洛克兰矿区的开采比例吗？

say:3:1411404003:1.text: Yes, in this way, processing and forging can be carried out directly underground. We can also fully utilize Sal'thorin's unique technology.
say:3:1411404003:1.source_cn: 是的，这样可以直接在地下进行加工乃至锻冶，也能充分利用...

say:4:1411404004:1.text: Because currently, everything is transported to the surface first, where we will conduct screening and rough processing, and then return everything back underground.
say:4:1411404004:1.source_cn: 现在还是先统一运送到地面，由矮人进行筛选和粗加工，然后...

say:5:1411404005:1.text: Yes, I understand the new metals and materials are still being tested and stabilized. Although this method is troublesome, it is indeed safer.
say:5:1411404005:1.source_cn: 嗯，在新材料性质尚待测验和稳定的时候，这样的做法虽然麻...

say:6:1411404006:1.text: I'm also looking forward to this new cooperation with Sal'thorin and what it can bring forth in the future.
say:6:1411404006:1.source_cn: 不过，我也很期待今后进一步深入合作后，萨洛克兰能带来的...

choice_prompt:7:1411404006.text: I'm also looking forward to this new cooperation with Sal'thorin and what it can bring forth in the future.
choice_prompt:7:1411404006.source_cn: 不过，我也很期待今后进一步深入合作后，萨洛克兰能带来的全新灵感。

say:8:1411404007:1.text: No need to worry. Sal'thorin is still being internally assessed and remains a state secret.
say:8:1411404007:1.source_cn: 哈哈，别担心，现在萨洛克兰还是内部研判，对外保密的状态。
say:8:1411404007:1.male: No need to worry. Sal'thorin is still being internally assessed and remains a state secret.
say:8:1411404007:1.female: No need to worry. Sal'thorin is still being internally assessed and remains a state secret.

say:9:1411404008:1.text: Before coming here, both Evie and General Hogan informed me of their circumstances. I have my own sources as well, so I naturally heard about the city.
say:9:1411404008:1.source_cn: 不过嘛，来这里之前，伊芙和霍根将军都为我做过介绍，我也...
say:9:1411404008:1.male: Before coming here, both Evie and General Hogan informed me of their circumstances. I have my own sources as well, so I naturally heard about the city.
say:9:1411404008:1.female: Before coming here, both Evie and General Hogan informed me of their circumstances. I have my own sources as well, so I naturally heard about the city.

say:10:1411404011:1.text: In that case, maybe I can make a few introductions. Ravion and Indris have expressed interest in gradually connecting with the outside world.
say:10:1411404011:1.source_cn: 既然这样，我来牵个线如何？我想，沙利叶和因度厄他们肯定...

say:11:1411404012:1.text: Private introductions before establishing official diplomatic relations... Bold! I love being bold.
say:11:1411404012:1.source_cn: 抢在官方之前的私下对接……大胆的想法，但正好我也有这份胆量。

say:12:1411404013:1.text: Please arrange our meeting at your earliest convenience. I look forward to meeting the leaders of Sal'thorin.
say:12:1411404013:1.source_cn: 那么，如果方便的话，就请你安排了，祖娅，我很期待能与萨...

say:13:1411404014:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我一定会传达到位的！

say:14:1411404015:1.text: As the conversation between the two of them grows more animated, you share amused and astonished looks with your familiars.
say:14:1411404015:1.source_cn: 眼看前方的二人越聊越热火朝天，落在后方的你们不禁面面相觑。
say:14:1411404015:1.male: As the conversation between the two of them grows more animated, you share amused and astonished looks with your familiars.
say:14:1411404015:1.female: As the conversation between the two of them grows more animated, you share amused and astonished looks with your familiars.

say:16:1411404016:1.text: Chippy doesn't know what to say, but Baelran doesn't really look like a Celestial.
say:16:1411404016:1.source_cn: 该怎么说呢，这个巴赫朗，真的一点也不像半神啊。

say:17:1411404017:1.text: Dionel looked like the classic playboy type. He was indifferent to everything except parties and Hypogeans.
say:17:1411404017:1.source_cn: 虽然萨基塔里斯也是那种花花公子的样子，但他除了酒宴和恶...

say:18:1411404018:1.source_cn: 巴赫朗就……该怎么形容好呢？

say:19:1411404019:1.text: Chippy knows what you mean! It seems like Baelran is interested in everything. He asked about the ore and metals, the processing, and even Sal'thorin.
say:19:1411404019:1.source_cn: 我懂我懂，他会有一种，对矿物以及加工，投资回报，萨洛克...
say:19:1411404019:1.male: Chippy knows what you mean! It seems like Baelran is interested in everything. He asked about the ore and metals, the processing, and even Sal'thorin.
say:19:1411404019:1.female: Chippy knows what you mean! It seems like Baelran is interested in everything. He asked about the ore and metals, the processing, and even Sal'thorin.

say:20:1411404020:1.text: His concern for these everyday affairs makes him different from the other Celestials.
say:20:1411404020:1.source_cn: 无论原因是什么，他这种“对日常事务的关心”，就让他显得...

say:22:1411404021:1.text: Well, he gave up the prestige and honor of being a Celestial. After the Divine War, he <style="highlight">retired</style>.
say:22:1411404021:1.source_cn: 因为他放弃了自己身为半神的尊荣，在神魔大战之后，就选择...

say:23:1411404022:1.text: He gave up all his responsibilities as a Celestial and decided to enjoy <style="highlight">a peaceful life</style>.
say:23:1411404022:1.source_cn: 他也放弃了身为半神的责任，退休之后，就决定彻底享受<s...

say:24:1411404023:1.text: Because he gave up his Celestial past, he was able to focus on his ordinary life.
say:24:1411404023:1.source_cn: 因为不再执着于半神的尊贵与责任，因此他把自己的注意力集...

say:25:1411404024:1.text: This went on for a long time, and he gradually became a well-known investor in the Empire.
say:25:1411404024:1.source_cn: 而且就这样持续了很长时间，甚至成为了人类社会中有名的投...

choice_prompt:26:1411404024.text: This went on for a long time, and he gradually became a well-known investor in the Empire.
choice_prompt:26:1411404024.source_cn: 而且就这样持续了很长时间，甚至成为了人类社会中有名的投资商人。

say:27:1411404025:1.text: For a Celestial to forget one's duties and care only for mortal affairs is the epitome of failure.
say:27:1411404025:1.source_cn: 作为半神，忘却本职，只关心人间的事务，已经很失败了。
say:27:1411404025:1.male: For a Celestial to forget one's duties and care only for mortal affairs is the epitome of failure.
say:27:1411404025:1.female: For a Celestial to forget one's duties and care only for mortal affairs is the epitome of failure.

say:28:1411404026:1.text: And if he did not succeed at all in the mortal realm, then he'd be a failure times two.
say:28:1411404026:1.source_cn: 如果在人间的事务上还无法取得成功，那才是失败中的失败。
say:28:1411404026:1.male: And if he did not succeed at all in the mortal realm, then he'd be a failure times two.
say:28:1411404026:1.female: And if he did not succeed at all in the mortal realm, then he'd be a failure times two.

say:29:1411404029:1.text: We've been watching over Baelran's "retirement" for a while without acting, but things have changed.
say:29:1411404029:1.source_cn: 我们已经旁观巴赫朗休息了许久，但如今已经不同了。

say:30:1411404030:1.text: The Hypogeans have returned. It's time for him to come out of retirement. We've been trying to remind him of this.
say:30:1411404030:1.source_cn: 恶魔重现于世，他的休假也应当结束了，这才是我们提醒他的原因。

say:32:1411404031:1.text: Well, maybe your reminders are a bit too... over... overbeer... loud!
say:32:1411404031:1.source_cn: 呃，话是这么说，你们的提醒也有点太尖锐——

say:34:1411404032:0.text: Wait, Magister. Did you just hear that?
say:34:1411404032:0.source_cn: 咦，主人，你有没有听到什么声音？
say:34:1411404032:0.male: Wait, Magister. Did you just hear that?
say:34:1411404032:0.female: Wait, Magister. Did you just hear that?

say:40:1411404027:1.female: You say that, Merlin, but you've always been very responsible with your duties.

say:41:1411404028:1.source_cn: 或许正是因为你一直在努力，所以才会想要休息，梅林。

choice:7:0:1.male: So, you're fully aware of Sal'thorin.
choice:7:0:1.female: So, you're fully aware of Sal'thorin.
